parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning, Shaw's restaurant.

Hi, I'd like to book one of your function rooms for a party, please.

Okay, fine. How many people are you expecting for the party?

Well, I'm not quite sure yet, but about 60.

Fine. So you will need a big room. And what day were you thinking of?

The party's for my daughter's birthday. It's her 21st. Her birthday is on the 17th of November, but that's a Friday. So we thought we'd have her party on the 18th as that's a Saturday. There'll be lots of her friends there as well as all the family

And what time would you like the room for?

Oh, I'm not sure. 7.45? Not too late.

Okay.

And people will probably be leaving about 11.

Fine. We're open until 11.30.

Excellent. And what about the menu?

So do you want a sit-down meal with waiter service?

Yes, not a buffet.

Right. Well, there are several options including different menus at various prices. So there's the standard menu that's 25 pounds per person.

Okay.

Or the celebration menu which is three courses is very popular. That's 35 pounds.

Okay. I think I'd rather go with that. And there's also our goldmenu that's a five-course menu at 50 pounds.

No, that's definitely too expensive.

OK

Now, not all the guests eat meat. Will there be something for them?

Of course. We'll make sure there's a vegetarian option for each course

Great.

And do you know if any of the guests have food allergies? Anything like shellfish, for example?

I'll need to check, but I do know that one of my daughter's friends is very allergic to strawberries. Even just being near them can be a problem.

Okay. I'll make a note to our chef to avoid those completely. Do you have any other requests for desserts?

Well, I'd like a choice if possible. And could we have cheese as well?

Of course, no problem. We can provide that.

Now, do you have any other requests I could help with? What about after dinner entertainment? You can book a band if you'd like live music.

Actually, I think a disco would be best if you can arrange that/ - No problem.

And I heard you might be able to put on a fireworks display. Is that possible?

We aren't offering that service anymore, I'm afraid It was just too expensive. / - Oh, I see

Now, the menu package you've chosen includes a few other nice things.

Oh, like what?

We'll decorate the room for you which creates a nice party atmospheere. We can use different colors for the balloons. Silver, gold..

She loves pink, but actually, I think she'd prefer flowers to balloons. So, let's go for them instead in the same color.

No problem. Now, you mentioned that the party's for your daughter. We make birthday cakes if you'd like one.

Okay, yes. We'll definitely want a cake.

And we can put a special message on top. What would you like?

Um, congratulations and then her name. That's Susie. /- Fine.

Now, one or two of the guests are coming by train, but they stop running quite early. So, they'll need a taxi to take them to the Forest hotel after the party. Is that something you can sort out?

Absolutely. Anything else?

I think that's all for now.

Okay. Well, just get in touch if you think of anything else. Now, if I cant take some contact details, I just need your name and phone number.

I'm Maria Nelson and my numbers 07749132760.

Excellent. We look forward to seeing you soon.

analyses.content: 女士被问到什么时候需要用房间（Starting time），她虽然说不确定，但紧接着提出了具体时间 7.45。
And what time would you like the room for? Oh, I'm not sure. 7.45? Not too late. Okay. And people will probably be leaving about 11. Fine. We're open until 11.30.
你听到后面的 11 或 11.30 可能会想填，但那分别是客人离开的时间和餐厅关门的时间，不是开始时间。
Or the celebration menu which is three courses is very popular. That's 35 pounds. Okay. I think I'd rather go with that. And there's also our gold menu that's a five-course menu at 50 pounds.
注意听价格对应关系，standard menu 是 25，gold menu 是 50，不要张冠李戴。
根据题目提示的 $35（英镑），录音中明确提到 celebration menu 的价格是 35 pounds，且女士最终选择了这个。
Now, not all the guests eat meat. Will there be something for them? Of course. We'll make sure there's a vegetarian option for each course.
不要听到 guests eat meat 就填 meat，原文是说“Not all guests eat meat”（不是所有人都吃肉），语义刚好相反。
女士提到不是所有客人都吃肉，男士立刻确认每一道菜都会保证有 vegetarian（素食）选项。
And do you know if any of the guests have food allergies? Anything like shellfish, for example? I'll need to check, but I do know that one of my daughter's friends is very allergic to strawberries.
前面的 shellfish（贝类）是服务员举例询问的过敏源，不是女士确认的实际过敏物。
女士明确表示她女儿的一个朋友对 strawberries（草莓）严重过敏。
Do you have any other requests for desserts? Well, I'd like a choice if possible. And could we have cheese as well? Of course, no problem.
你可能听到 "I'd like a choice" 想填 choice，但 choice 是抽象概念，题目问的是具体食物名称。
女士询问除了甜点（desserts）之外，能否也提供 cheese（芝士/奶酪），服务员表示没问题。

groups.contentHtml:
Entertainment: book a after dinner
Room decoration: pink
Special request: write 'Susie' on the birthday cake
Book a to take guests to the Forest Hotel
Phone number:

analyses.content: 服务员建议了乐队（band），但女士明确表示她觉得 disco 会是最好的选择（would be best）。
What about after dinner entertainment? You can book a band if you'd like live music. Actually, I think a disco would be best if you can arrange that.
不要填 band（被否决了）或 fireworks（烟花，餐厅不再提供这项服务了）。
We can use different colors for the balloons. Silver, gold.. She loves pink, but actually, I think she'd prefer flowers to balloons. So, let's go for them instead in the same color.
千万别填 balloons，文中明确说了 "prefer flowers to balloons"（比起气球更喜欢花），这是一种典型的否定干扰。
题目已知 pink，录音中女士说虽然女儿喜欢粉色，但比起气球（balloons），她更倾向于要 flowers（花），并指明要“同样的颜色”（即粉色）。
And we can put a special message on top. What would you like? Um, congratulations and then her name. That's Susie.
题目空后已经有了 'Susie'，所以空里只需要填这个特定的祝福语单词，不要漏写 s。
题目问要在蛋糕上写什么，女士回答写 congratulations 加上名字 Susie。
Now, one or two of the guests are coming by train, but they stop running quite early. So, they'll need a taxi to take them to the Forest hotel after the party.
不要听到 train 就填，原文逻辑是火车不行了，所以才需要出租车。
因为火车（train）停运很早，所以客人离开时需要一辆 taxi（出租车）去酒店。
Now, if I can take some contact details, I just need your name and phone number. I'm Maria Nelson and my numbers 07749132760.
这道题没有干扰项，唯一的易错点就是数字没跟上或者写错位，注意双写数字通常会读作 "double X"。
纯数字听写，女士直接报出了电话号码 07749132760。
